description: Executable Candidate recipe of NVIDIA's own DGX Spark playbook (speculative-decoding) for gpt-oss 120b Eagle3 speculative decoding: the NGC TensorRT-LLM release image 1.3.0rc12 (pinned by arm64 digest) serving the exact model revision through trtllm-serve with the playbook's LLM API options. Resource envelopes are estimates from the playbook's 0.8-0.9 KV memory fraction, not measurements; physical Spark acceptance is pending.
title: gpt-oss 120b Eagle3 speculative decoding TensorRT-LLM single Spark (NVIDIA playbook)
